en-US.longDescription: KTurtle is an educational programming environment for learning how to program. It provides all programming tools from its user interface. The programming language used is TurtleScript, which is loosely based on Logo. All commands and messages are translated into the user's language. KTurtle features an intuitive syntax highlighting, simple error messages, integrated canvas to make drawings, an integrated help, slow-motion and step execution.
en-US.name: kturtle

zh-CN.longDescription: KTurtle 是一个用于学习编程的教育编程环境，其用户界面提供各类编程工具。它使用类似于 Logo 的 TurtleScript 编程语言，且所有命令和信息都会翻译成用户可读的语言。KTurtle 具有直观的语法高亮显示、简单的错误信息、用于绘图的集成画布、集成帮助、慢动作和步骤执行功能。
